review_scope: Read only the completed target-generalization diagnosis summary JSON; did not open its NPZ, GT, labels, count rows, graph, query or base artifacts. Checked all40 contrast and440 stratum summary totals/algebra, not a new empirical rerun.
supported_interpretations: WebVid has observed pilot concentration transfer: lambda1 lowers pilot mean D by0.2985 and increases absolute top4 mass by1.808pp, though the fit gain is much larger. A claim of no pilot concentration transfer is false for this dataset.

WebVid main greedy3 oracle_probability net losses are -0.866/-0.790pp; seen-target contributions are -0.870/-0.753pp, unseen contributions+0.004/-0.037pp. These are descriptive additive net hit differences, so an all-unseen failure explanation is contradicted.

WebVid seen-target absolute selected-leaf coverage contribution itself increases1.976pp while the corresponding seen-target retrieval contribution falls in both main search cells. Abstract target membership/concentration does not guarantee better finite-budget joint search.

Yandex fit mean D drops3.00925→1.96480, while aggregate pilot D changes3.0181→3.0193 and M4 changes-0.004pp. Report these small observed differences; they do not prove statistical equivalence or that every subgroup is unchanged.

Pilot seen target-slot share differs sharply:57.258% WebVid and10.163% Yandex; counts of queries with no seenGT target are554 and5189. These describe target-support exposure, not query overlap/leakage.

Final lambda1-versuslambda0 label differences occur for24.1695%/11.7641% of seen unique nodes versus0.9886%/0.5084% of unseen unique nodes. This supports empirically checking whether the algebraic degree condition covers actual fit targets and changed-label populations. It does not show why particular sequential moves were accepted.
unsupported_interpretations: All P3 failure arises from targets absent from fit.
No pilot target concentration transferred on either dataset.
Seen-target losses have their own confirmed statistical interval; this diagnostic computes no subgroup CI.
The existing Yandex inconclusive main search contrasts have become confirmed algorithmic regression because a descriptive subgroup mean is negative.
M4 is an upper bound on Recall: cross-region edges and shared search can retrieve targets outside the four active leaves.
Endpoint label differences identify actual single-move deltaC/deltaS or isolate a label-only causal effect. The lambda pipeline also changes candidates/portals/oracle choices/queue assignments.
Fit-to-pilot differences prove memorization or connectivity failure, or authorize a model/auxiliary-graph revision.

bounded_degree_audit_feasibility.supported_next_question: Among actual fit-target and frozen changed-label populations, what fraction satisfies the fixed sufficient bound D(u)*9Q<M, and how does that relate descriptively to fit incidence?
bounded_degree_audit_feasibility.evidence_justification: Global Markov arithmetic cannot locate fit-target degrees; target diagnosis shows both finite support exposure differences and different label-change rates across support groups. A degree/incidence audit addresses that specific missing empirical premise.
bounded_degree_audit_feasibility.permitted_claim_if_condition_common: The sufficient local degree condition applies to that observed population, conditional on a feasible candidate with net deltaS<=-1.
bounded_degree_audit_feasibility.claims_still_unavailable: No proof that the condition caused actual accepted moves, search loss, poor paths, or a connectivity bottleneck. Final labels do not replay sequential moves.
bounded_degree_audit_feasibility.implementation_boundary: Requires separate frozen protocol and root-controlled run. Keep fixedlambda1 objective and threshold, no parameter optimization, new ANN, pilot/validation/heldout reads, graph edits or gate reopening.
